about: What fails the server-bench gate (ci/box/server_bench.py). Each number of bench/bench.py's result, flattened to <cell>.<key>, takes the FIRST rule whose glob matches; a number no rule matches is report-only. A gated number fails when the head is worse than base * (1 + rel) + abs (worse = higher), or base * (1 - rel) - abs (worse = lower). Accepting a cost is a reviewed change to this file in the pull request that brings it.
method: Margins come from five full runs (bench.py, no --quick) of the same plugin code on the bench box on 2026-11-13 between 12:49 and 14:05 UTC, load 2-4.2 at the start of each: three of d466439, then base 18347d7 and head 330017b of the first gate run (which change only CI files). 'max/min' below is the largest run over the smallest, the worst pair a gate run could draw. Timings are gated at +15% only where max/min was 10% or less; exact-ish numbers (bytes, allocation, counts) at a margin of about twice their max/min, with a floor for values rounded to two decimals; everything noisier is report-only.
